name: dojs-os-dosbox
description: Launch, restart and stop dojs-os under DOSBox-X from VS Code, with DOSBox-X/DOjS logs streamed to an Output channel.

dojs.dosboxXPath.description: Path to the DOSBox-X executable (or just 'dosbox-x' if it is on PATH).

dojs.mode.description: dev: mount the source tree (edit .js on host, re-run — no zip). packaged: run dist/DOJSOS.ZIP (tools/build-zip.sh runs first).

dojs.target.description: dev mode only: run RUN.BAT (seeds JSBOOT.ZIP, then MAIN.JS) or invoke DOJS.EXE on MAIN.JS directly.

dojs.configPath.description: Optional: use this DOSBox-X .conf file verbatim instead of a generated one (e.g. dosbox/dosbox-x-dev.conf).

dojs.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the dosbox-x invocation.

dojs.autoBuildZip.description: Packaged mode: run tools/build-zip.sh before launching so DOJSOS.ZIP is fresh.
